rule: Places in one tie group differ pairwise by less than the sensor-noise threshold of the target's relief class: the 95th percentile of D between NASADEM and Copernicus GLO-30 over the dev regions of that class (data/derived/validation/noise_v1.3.json, classes.<class>.p95; STANDARDS 10.11). Groups are formed by the anchor rule: a new group starts when D minus the first D of the current group reaches the threshold.
